source.source_title: iMac (24-inch, M6, Four ports) - Tech Specs
source.verification_notes: Official Apple Support page returned successfully and its HTML was archived. Original visible specification sections were extracted; individual field values have not yet been independently normalized or verified.

extraction.note: Apple's original section headings and visible source text are retained in source order. Connectivity, port, memory, storage and other configurations remain within the same source record where Apple presents them together.

sections.heading: External Display Support
sections.source_text:
Supports up to two external displays over Thunderbolt ports:
Two displays up to a native resolution of 6K at 60Hz or 4K at 165Hz, or
One display up to a native resolution of 8K at 60Hz or 5K at 120Hz or 4K at 240Hz
Supports up to two external displays over Thunderbolt port
Simultaneously supports the built‑in display at full native resolution
Thunderbolt 4 (USB‑C) ports support native DisplayPort 1.4 speeds

sections.source_text:

HDR with Dolby Vision, HDR10+/HDR10 and HLG

sections.heading: Audio Playback
sections.source_text: Supported formats include AAC, MP3, Apple Lossless, FLAC, Dolby Digital, Dolby Digital Plus and Dolby Atmos

sections.heading: Apple Intelligence and Siri AI 1
sections.source_text:
The next generation of Apple Intelligence is centred around you, integrated into your apps and built with privacy. Apple Intelligence powers Siri AI — an entirely new version of Siri that’s more personal, conversational and powerful, along with helpful features across apps.

sections.heading: iMac and the Environment
sections.source_text:
Progress towards Apple 2030
Apple 2030 is our goal to be carbon neutral across our value chain. We design our products to be less carbon intensive by prioritising the use of recycled and renewable content and low‑carbon materials while focusing on the energy efficiency of our software and hardware.
See Apple’s commitment
See the iMac Product Environmen­tal Report (PDF)
Materials
iMac is made with 15% recycled content,
8
including:
100% recycled aluminium in the stand
50% recycled glass in the standard glass
9
100% recycled gold plating in all Apple‑designed printed circuit boards
50% recycled plastic in multiple components
9
100% recycled rare earth elements in all magnets
100% recycled tin solder in all Apple‑designed printed circuit boards
Packaging
100% fibre‑based packaging
10
Energy
ENERGY STAR® certified
11
Smarter chemistry
12
All the materials used in Apple products, accessories and packaging are covered by the requirements of our
Regulated Substances Specification (PDF)
, which was one of the first in industry to restrict the use of key substances of concern. See the latest
Environmen­tal Progress Report (PDF)
to understand Apple’s recent efforts in phasing out these chemistries.
